title: Arrow Jam 3D: Logic Puzzle
fullDescription:
Arrow Jam 3D is a tricky 3D arrow logic puzzle. Every level is a cube of jammed arrows — tap an arrow to send it flying, clear its path, and unjam the cube to escape. Simple to learn, hard to master.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap an arrow to send it flying in its direction.
• An arrow only leaves when its straight path is fully clear.
• Unjam the arrows in the right order and empty the cube to win.

FEATURES
• 1000 hand-crafted 3D levels, from easy to expert.
• Endless mode — a fresh, always-solvable puzzle every time.
• One-hand tap controls. Rotate the cube to spot hidden chains.
• A free hint when a level gets tricky.
• Clean 3D art and smooth, satisfying moves.
• Free to play.

If you love logic puzzles, brain teasers, maze games, and 3D puzzle games, Arrow Jam 3D is your next obsession. Think ahead, tap smart, and clear every cube.
shortDescription: Tap arrows, clear the 3D cube — 1000 brain-teasing logic puzzle levels.
